headline: Shein to Pay $100 Million to Settle FTC Trade Allegations
summary: Fast-fashion retailer Shein agreed to pay $100 million to settle Federal Trade Commission allegations that it misled consumers regarding shipping times, product reviews, and the origin of cotton used in its goods.
why: Regulatory settlements involving major retailers highlight compliance risks and supply chain transparency standards.

impacts.name: Shein
impacts.why: A substantial financial penalty directly impacts corporate cash flow and regulatory standing.
